newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER SHOWCASE-MILAN'S ALBERTINI OUT FOR 10 DAYS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-MILAN'S ALBERTINI OUT FOR 10 DAYS.

text.p: AC Milan's Italy midfielder Demetrio Albertini will miss the serie A match against Juventus on Sunday and will be sidelined for around two weeks after surgery, the Italian club said on Thursday.

Albertini did not play in Italy's 0-0 draw against Poland in a World Cup qualifier on Wednesday after complaining of pain in a testicle. The club said he had undergone minor surgery in hospital to drain a blood clot.
Milan said Albertini would spend two days in hospital and must then rest for seven to 10 days, making it unlikely that he would take part in the derby against Internazionale on April 13.
